standards.index: table:transition — edition key; used to pick the newest edition per standard number and to pair old/new editions
standards.standard_number: kpi:total, chart-reform, table:transition, chart-gaz-std — joins editions, the reform list and gazette mentions
standards.standard_name: chart-topics, insight:topic, table:transition, chart-gaz-std — topic = name up to the first colon
standards.standard_number_and_name: skip: concatenation of standard_number and standard_name (both used)
standards.validity_from: table:transition — entry date of the replacing edition
standards.mandatory_sections: chart-process — count of partially-official standards quoted in the note
standards.note: skip: free-text remarks on 16 distinct cases (exemptions, publication notes)
standards.standard_import_conditions: chart-groups — count of standards with group-split conditions quoted in the note; the conditions themselves are free text
standards.is_standard_mandatory: chart-orig — count quoted in the note
standards.adoption_conditions_united: skip: HTML blob of route conditions; the routes themselves are read from is_in_cassis / is_in_international_regulations and the routes file
standards.is_in_international_regulation: skip: derived OR of is_in_cassis and is_in_international_regulations (chart-routes shows the full cross-tab)
routes.index: chart-cassis — distinct standards and multi-route standards quoted in the note
routes.standard_number: skip: duplicate of the register's standard_number (joined via index)
routes.stndr_name: skip: duplicate of the register's standard_name
routes.standard_edition: skip: duplicate of the register's standard_edition
routes.validity_from: skip: duplicate of the register's validity_from
routes.validity_to: skip: duplicate of the register's validity_to
routes.conditions: chart-bodies — count of routes with scope conditions quoted in the note; conditions are free text
routes.documents_combination: chart-bodies — standards bodies parsed from the required-document formula
routes.additional_documents_for_specific: chart-bodies — count quoted in the note
routes.detailed_comments: chart-bodies — count of routes marked exempt from import testing quoted in the note
gazette.publication: chart-actions — publication venue split quoted in the note
gazette.title: skip: free-text formal title; the action type comes from summary_full
gazette.summary: chart-actions — fallback when summary_full is empty
gazette.gen_info: skip: free-text extra details (88 distinct, mostly 'אין מידע נוסף')
gazette.file: skip: HTML link to the gazette PDF
reform.standard_edition: chart-reform — latest edition year quoted in the note
reform.standard_name: skip: same standards as the register; compared by number only
reform.validity_from: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.validity_to: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.amendments: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.mandatory_sections: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.note: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.standard_process: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.standard_originality: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.standard_import_groups: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.standard_import_conditions: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.is_standard_mandatory: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.is_in_cassis: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.is_in_international_regulations: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
reform.is_in_international_regulations_o: skip: older snapshot; compared by number only
eu.directive_hebrew_name: chart-eu, insight:eu — type and eco-design topic
eu.comments: chart-eu — count quoted in the note
eu.terms: chart-eu — count quoted in the note; terms are free text
eu.fileen: skip: HTML link to the English text
eu.filehe: skip: HTML link to the Hebrew text
